# RepairRange

> Australian phone, tablet, laptop, console and wearable repair cost guide. Independently researched, transparent pricing for screen, battery, charging port, water damage and software repairs, plus repair-vs-replace guidance, screen quality tiers, and Australian consumer repair rights. Repairs performed by Mayfield Phone Repair, Newcastle NSW.

## How our pricing is compiled
- [How we collect our data](https://repairrange.io/how-we-collect-data.html): methodology behind every price range on this site

- [Samsung](https://repairrange.io/brands/samsung.html): Galaxy S, A, Z-series phones

- [Google](https://repairrange.io/brands/google.html): Pixel repair costs

- [Samsung Galaxy repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/samsung-galaxy-repair-cost-australia.html): S, A and foldable Z series

## Cost guides — computers, consoles, wearables and audio
- [Windows laptop repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/windows-laptop-repair-cost-australia.html): Dell, HP, Lenovo, ASUS and Acer screens, batteries, keyboards, hinges and motherboards
- [MacBook repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/macbook-laptop-repair-cost-guide-australia.html)
- [Nintendo Switch repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/nintendo-switch-repair-cost-australia.html): Joy-Con drift, Hall-effect stick upgrades, Switch / Lite / OLED screens and ports
- [PS5 repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/ps5-repair-cost-australia.html): HDMI, disc drive, DualSense charging port and stick drift
- [Steam Deck and ROG Ally repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/steam-deck-rog-ally-repair-cost-australia.html): the handheld market's published prices and quote-only faults
- [Apple Watch repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/apple-watch-repair-cost-australia.html): screen and battery by series
- [AirPods repair cost](https://repairrange.io/blog/airpods-repair-cost-australia.html): single-bud and case replacement, battery service, AppleCare+ rates
